lines.en: I land on the branch and hop twice.
A flash of blue between the leaves.
I hop along the branch to its tip.

lines.zh: 我从这棵树飞到那棵树
lines.en: I flit from this tree to that one.
I hop about the ground hunting seeds.
My long tail keeps me balanced.
I skim past the low branches.
I bounce in short hops on the grass.
I twist my head to look behind.
I head for that berry bush.
I fly a stretch, then rest.
The leaves sway; I move elsewhere.
I perch with my feathers fluffed.
I give one bright, sharp call.
I call again. Nothing answers.

lines.zh: 低头理了理胸前的蓝羽。
lines.en: I tuck my blue breast feathers down.
The wind rocks the branch gently.
I'm watching the ground.

lines.zh: 我把头歪过来，又歪回去
lines.en: I tip my head, then tip it back.
An insect crawls on the bark.
One peck and I have it.
I shake my wings and fold them.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候，我正看你
lines.en: When you looked up, I was watching.
I tilt my head, blue crest raised.
Your hand has touched my branch.
I call once. You don't understand.

lines.zh: 我跳到更高的枝上看你。
lines.en: I hop to a higher branch to watch you.

lines.zh: 你的影子在草地上很长
lines.en: Your shadow is long on the grass.
I know that angle of your gaze.
Reach out, and I fly.
I'll look at you a little longer.
Your movements are too sudden.
I shriek and take off.

lines.zh: 蓝羽散在草上，我发着抖。
lines.en: Blue feathers scatter on the grass as I tremble.
The blue jay's wingtip is crooked.
I drop into the bushes to hide.
I have only a little life in me.

lines.zh: 翅膀合不拢，我缩着脖子。
lines.en: My wings won't fold; I tuck my neck.
I try to flap; it hurts.

lines.zh: 我的蓝羽一抖，就有人想抓我。
lines.en: One shake of blue feathers and someone wants me.
I shrink into a small blue ball.
Wings drooping, I retreat to the branch tip.

lines.zh: 那些是种子吗，给我看看。
lines.en: Are those seeds? Let me see.

lines.zh: 种子落在土上，我没敢下。
lines.en: Seeds fall on the soil; I dare not descend.
I can eat that.
Scatter it on the ground and I'll come.

lines.zh: 我落到离你两步的枝上。
lines.en: I land on a branch two steps from you.
Then I stop again.
That smells good.
Step back and I'll dare to eat.
I peck once and look up.
Too quick — I've flown off.
Startled, I take off.
Your hand brushed my tail feathers.
I land on a higher branch.
A few blue feathers fall.
I fly right over your head.
I return to the same tree.
I keep clear of where you stand.
One hop and I'm clear.
That much contact is too much for me.

lines.zh: 你的靴子比树皮硬多了
lines.en: Your boots are far harder than bark.
You have blue on you too.
Our calls don't match.
There's room on the branch.
I'll hop over; then you hop over.
Hunting seeds together is quicker.
There's a cat below. Don't go down.

lines.zh: 我守着这根枝，你去那边
lines.en: I'll keep this branch; you take that.
At dusk we go to our own nests.

lines.zh: 两根枝之间，我们对着叫。
lines.en: Between two branches, we call to each other.
Be careful. Don't land on the grass.
I peck up a seed.
The seed is slick; I pick it up and drop it.
Too big; I can't hold it.
I tuck it into a crack in the bark.
What drops, I leave.
One seed isn't a meal.
I gather them one by one.
Another bird is watching; I'll hurry.
I pin it under a claw.
I take it and fly off.
A rustle in the grass.
I lift my head, every feather taut.
The shadow is moving this way.
I hop further out on the branch.

lines.zh: 我的蓝羽，林子里最显眼。
lines.en: My blue feathers stand out here.
Other birds have started calling.
I stare under that leaf.
Something's at the base of the tree.
My tail bobs up and down.
I shift my weight to my legs.
My legs coil, wings half open.
If it gets closer, that's bad.
First I look, then I call.
No other birds in that direction.
I flatten my feathers.

lines.zh: 它停在树根边，我压低身子。
lines.en: It stops by the roots; I crouch low.
I still can't relax.
The wind brings its scent.
I shift my feet three times on the branch.

lines.zh: 它在草里挪，我盯紧那片叶。
lines.en: It shifts in the grass; I fix on that leaf.
I shift to a higher branch.
It's looking elsewhere.
I slip around the trunk.
My call has dropped low.
It's only steps from the tree.
I can't keep my footing still.
One step closer and I go.
I'm watching its hands.
My blue feathers puff and I start scolding
I shrink into the leaf shadow.
It can't see me.
I hold perfectly still.
It's moving to the other side.
I quietly change position.
The wind nudged the branch.
I nearly lost my balance.
It takes another step.
I've decided to fly.
I lunge and peck once.
It's the only move I have.
My wings beat against its face.
One peck and I'm gone.
I rake with my claws once.
That is far too little force.

lines.zh: 翅膀拍在它脸上，乱成一团。
lines.en: My wings beat its face in a flurry.
I drove it away from my nest.
Every feather is puffed out.
After the peck, I fly back to a high branch.
I fly back to the branch, panting.
My heart hasn't settled.
It's still nearby.
I'm ready to try again.
This time I'll go for the eyes.
I dive.
I graze past its shoulder.
I climb again.
It's covering its face.
I land in a distant tree.
I land on this branch.

lines.zh: 我理了理被风吹乱的毛
lines.en: I tidy my wind-blown feathers.
There are many perches in this crown.
I call twice, testing.
One of my kind calls back.

lines.zh: 我朝那个方向飞了一段
lines.en: I fly a stretch that way.
The trees here are thick.
I spot seeds on the ground.

lines.zh: 我还没决定要不要下去
lines.en: I haven't decided whether to go down.
The wind has paused.
I hop to a lower branch.
Then back up high.

lines.zh: 半边翅膀焦了，飞不起来。
lines.en: Half my wing is scorched; I can't fly.

lines.zh: 我从枝上掉下去，摔在草里
lines.en: I drop from the branch into the grass.
Water plasters my feathers together.
The blast flings me far.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西穿过我的翅
lines.en: Something sharp goes through my wing.
A flash blinds me.
No seeds to find; I grow weak.
The thunder startles me off the tree.
I fall and fall; my wings don't help.
